form.hours_hint: Used to work out a yearly amount. Leave empty for 40.
form.salary_months_hint: For example 13 or 15. Leave empty for 12.
form.bonus_amount_hint: Only if the offer names an amount. Added to the totals.
form.bonus_text: Bonus, as the offer says it
form.bonus_text_hint: For example “10% target”. Shown, not added to the totals.
form.year_end: Year-end bonus, as the offer says it
form.year_end_hint: For example “2–4 months”. Shown, not added to the totals.
form.signing_hint: One-time. Counted in the first year only.
form.equity: Equity, as the offer says it
form.equity_hint: Shown as written. Equity is never given a value.
form.benefits: Social insurance, housing fund and hukou
form.si_base: Social insurance and housing fund base (a month)
form.hf_percent_hint: The company pays the same percent of the base.

error.base: Enter the base pay as a number above 0.
error.currency: Use a 3-letter currency code, like USD.
error.salary_months: Months of pay is a whole number from 12 to 24.
error.housing_fund_percent: The housing fund percent is a number from 0 to 12.
error.hours: Hours a week is a number from 1 to 80.
